description: Live NEAR state at the latest final block; every view call is pinned to `height`.

methods.gas_price: block header gas_price, yoctoNEAR per gas unit
methods.lst: meta-pool.near get_st_near_price / get_contract_state, linear-protocol.near ft_price; metapool_state *_near and stnear_supply are yocto / 1e24, *_bp are basis points
methods.pool_fees: top 25 current validators by stake, get_reward_fee_fraction (null where the account is not a staking-pool contract)
methods.protocol_reward_rate_rpc: verbatim RPC value. nearcore hard-codes the mainnet treasury share to 1/10 (reward_calculator.rs use_hardcoded_value); not reinterpreted here.
